_note: Customer deliverable languages. A deliverable is the customer-facing document derived from a reviewer-approved internal report in @reports; the internal report and its labels stay Turkish (see CLAUDE.md), the deliverable is written in the customer's language. The Validator reads this table: 'sections' are the '## ' headings it requires, 'fact_label' must appear at least once, 'template' is the file in @deliverable_templates. Adding a language: add a block here plus the matching template file, and add a case to tests/test_governance.py; no hook code changes. Machine fields (dil, kaynak_rapor, musteri, teslim_tarihi) live in the deliverable's frontmatter and stay Turkish — they are traceability data, not customer prose, and the delivered file is rendered without them.
